prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A counterclockwise circular arrow with an arrowhead pointing to the
upper-left, uniform stroke width, flat dark fill — standard reset /
undo glyph.
formatted_prompt: Flat UI app icon centered on an off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding. A single counterclockwise circular arrow glyph, uniform bold stroke width, arrowhead pointing upper-left — rendered as a solid filled shape in deep near-black (#0B0F14). The arc covers roughly three-quarters of a circle, terminating in a crisp angular arrowhead. Interior of the arc is open background. No gradients, no texture, no brushwork. Bold geometric silhouette with sharp vector edges, fully legible at 16px. Minimal, modern, SF Symbols Filled register.
